description: Write the ferry lane tally script so repeated card charges from the gate system's sync retries count once. DISTILL-CANARY-0a1908e7

files.tickets.py:
"""Print the lane tally for Gullwing Ferries.

The gate system drops one ticketing file per month into crossings/, one row
per card charge:

    charge_id,sold_on,route,passengers,pence

The lane tally is one line per route, in alphabetical order, counting every
charge once:

    <route>,<passengers>,<pence>
    TOTAL,<passengers>,<pence>
"""

if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit("the lane tally is not written yet")
files.README.md:
# Gullwing Ferries - lane tally

The gate system writes one ticketing file per month into crossings/. Its
sync job retried twice this month, so a few card charges were posted again
with their charge_id kept; a charge is billed once.
